page.notes: Text is in a mixture of roman and italic; the Greek-free page has no marginal notes. Some words are blurred by print quality and may be misread, notably "Vocius" (possibly Voetius), "Syons" and the roman numerals in the date "MDCXLIV" and "MDCXLIX", which appear as "clɔ Iɔ c xliv" and "clɔ Iɔ c xlix" in the scan. Printed "Ddd 2" signature and the catchword "slesia" are as printed.
